outputs.explanation: Panel a shows a schematic icon and example micrographs illustrating image cropping/rotation; it is not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel b shows a schematic and example micrographs illustrating image spacing; not a plot of averages.
Panel c shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating insets/magnification; not a plot of averages.
Panel d shows grayscale micrographs at different brightness/contrast levels with a schematic slider; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e shows schematic color circles and example channel micrographs; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel f shows a schematic venn-like icon and grayscale channel micrographs; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel g shows schematic calibration icons and micrographs with intensity scale bars; not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
